description.en: The Xiaomi MiMo desktop app's own account channel: the host opens a Xiaomi-account login window, harvests the session cookies itself, and the MiMo X models unlock — chat on the app's route gateway with cycle usage and the live model catalog. Falls back to pasting the account cookie on headless deployments.
description.zh: 小米 MiMo 桌面 App 自带账号通道：宿主自动打开小米账号登录窗口并收割会话 Cookie，直接解锁 MiMo X 模型——走 App 同款 route 网关聊天，附带周期额度与实时模型目录。无浏览器环境可退回手动粘贴账号 Cookie。

description.en: Opens a login window on the host: sign in with the Xiaomi account and the MiMo X session is harvested automatically — no codes, no cookie digging. On remote deployments, paste the account.xiaomi.com cookie block in the callback box instead.
description.zh: 在宿主上打开登录窗口：用小米账号登录后自动收割 MiMo X 会话——无需验证码，也不用翻开发者工具。远程部署时改为在回调框粘贴 account.xiaomi.com 的 Cookie。
